_comment: Default banner text, per language. These are the strings a visitor reads,
so they are shipped translated rather than left to the site owner to
write four times. Spanish is the reference: the others were written from
A site can override any of them under Languages. Adding a language means
adding a block here and listing it in Banner_Text::get_languages().
